hastemine.config.title: Hastemine Settings
hastemine.config.category.deepslate.desc: Instant mining with Haste II and mining at stone speed.
hastemine.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When OFF, mining is exactly vanilla.
hastemine.config.deepslate_instant.toolt: With Haste II (a beacon, a potion...), deepslate breaks at once whenever stone would with the same pickaxe and enchantments.
hastemine.config.deepslate_stone_speed.t: Deepslate takes exactly as long to mine as stone does with the same tool, with or without a beacon. Wood, stone, iron, diamond and netherite pickaxes each keep their own stone timing.
hastemine.config.cobblestone_instant.too: With Haste II, cobblestone breaks at once whenever stone would, as in Bedrock Edition. Without this, Java cobblestone is harder than stone and never breaks instantly.
hastemine.config.category.slabs.desc: Instant mining of pickaxe slabs with Haste II.
hastemine.config.slabs_instant.tooltip: With Haste II, any slab mined with a pickaxe (stone, cobblestone, bricks, andesite, diorite, granite, sandstone, deepslate, blackstone, copper...) breaks at once whenever stone would with the same pickaxe and enchantments. Wooden slabs are not affected.
hastemine.config.category.logs.desc: Instant mining with Haste II and Bedrock-style Haste for Overworld logs.
hastemine.config.logs_instant.tooltip: With Haste II (or higher) and any axe in hand, Overworld logs and stripped logs break at once. Wood blocks, Nether stems and bamboo are not affected.
hastemine.config.logs_haste.tooltip: Overworld logs and stripped logs are mined with Bedrock Edition's Haste scaling: Haste level n speeds mining up by (1 + 0.2n) as in Java, and by another 1.2^n on top. With Haste II that is about 2.02x instead of 1.4x, enough for a well-enchanted axe to break logs at once. Wood blocks, Nether stems and bamboo are not affected.
